tools.name: search_certifications
tools.title: Search certification catalog
tools.description: Search the SkillTrack-365 certification catalog by name, vendor, category or skill. Returns matching published certifications with slug, vendor, level and estimated cost.

query.description: Free-text search over certification name, vendor and category.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-25). Defaults to 10.

tools.name: list_my_certifications
tools.title: List my tracked certifications
tools.description: List the certifications the signed-in user is tracking, with status, study hours logged, target date and latest mock score.

status.description: Optional status filter, e.g. planned, in_progress, completed. Use an empty string for all.

tools.name: track_certification
tools.title: Track or update a certification
tools.description: Start tracking a certification for the signed-in user, or update an existing tracked certification's status, target date, study hours or notes.

certification_slug.description: Catalog slug of the certification, e.g. aws-saa-c03.

status.description: Tracking status: planned, in_progress, or completed. Empty string keeps the current value.

target_date.description: Target exam date as YYYY-MM-DD. Empty string leaves it unset.

study_hours.description: Total study hours logged so far. Use a negative number to leave unchanged.

notes.description: Free-form notes. Empty string leaves notes unchanged.

tools.name: list_milestones
tools.title: List study milestones
tools.description: List the signed-in user's study milestones with due dates and completion state, optionally filtered to a single certification slug.

certification_slug.description: Optional certification slug filter. Empty string returns all.

only_open.description: When true, return only milestones that are not yet completed.

tools.name: complete_milestone
tools.title: Complete or reopen a milestone
tools.description: Mark one of the signed-in user's study milestones as completed, or reopen it by clearing its completion timestamp.

milestone_id.description: The milestone id returned by list_milestones.

completed.description: True to mark completed, false to reopen the milestone.

tools.name: list_learning_paths
tools.title: List learning paths
tools.description: List learning paths visible to the signed-in user, including title, difficulty, estimated hours, target certification and step count.

query.description: Optional free-text filter on the learning path title. Empty string returns all.

limit.description: Maximum number of paths to return (1-25). Defaults to 10.
